function.name: web_search
function.description: Search the web for current information.

function.name: search_images
function.description: Search the web for high-resolution images, photos, illustrations, or diagrams. Returns image titles, direct URLs, and source attribution.

query.description: The search query describing the image/visual subject to look for

limit.description: Maximum number of images to return (1-6, default: 3)

function.name: search_videos
function.description: Search YouTube and web platforms for relevant video tutorials, explanations, demonstrations, or clips.

query.description: The topic, keyword, or title to find videos for

limit.description: Maximum number of videos to return (1-4, default: 2)

function.name: diagram_design
function.description: Generate or update a technical diagram, flowchart, sequence map, or system architecture rendered as clean, responsive SVG in the visual viewer.

prompt.description: The description or concept to visualize

svg.description: Clean, complete SVG code for the diagram
